import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { createRuntime } from '@kite-ai/agent';
import { createArtifactStore } from '@kite-ai/agent/artifacts';
import { createTemporaryCredentialBackend } from '@kite-ai/agent/config';
import { selectProfile } from '@kite-ai/agent/profile';
import { openSqliteStore } from '@kite-ai/agent/sqlite';
import { createFixedModel, type ModelEvent } from '@kite-ai/ai';
import { createDefaultProcessConfiguration } from '../../../../apps/service/src/configuration';
import { initializeLivePermissionFixture } from '../../../../apps/service/test/fixtures/live-permission-fixture';
import { privateDirectory, removeTemporaryDirectory, temporaryDirectory } from '../../test-filesystem';
import { defaultTaskRoles } from './roles';

const directory = temporaryDirectory('kite-legacy-role-capture-');
const profile = selectProfile({ dataRoot: join(directory, 'data'), profile: 'fixture' });
const workspace = join(directory, 'workspace');
privateDirectory(profile.profilePath);
privateDirectory(workspace);
const userConfigurationPath = join(profile.profilePath, 'config.jsonc');
writeFileSync(userConfigurationPath, JSON.stringify({
  modelId: 'history',
  models: [{ id: 'history', provider: 'compatible', model: 'controlled', baseURL: 'http://127.0.0.1:9/v1' }],
  tools: ['files.read', 'files.write', 'task.spawn', 'task.follow_up'].map(id => ({ id })),
}));
const host = createDefaultProcessConfiguration({ profile, userConfigurationPath, localCodex: false, browser: false, credentialBackend: createTemporaryCredentialBackend(), child: defaultTaskRoles });
const store = await openSqliteStore(profile);
const expectedStoreId = (await store.getMetadata()).storeId;
const finish: ModelEvent = { type: 'finish', reason: 'stop', usage: { inputTokens: 1, outputTokens: 1 } };
const runtime = createRuntime({
  ...host,
  store,
  permissions: host.permissions!,
  artifacts: createArtifactStore({ profile, store }),
  async resolveRunConfiguration(input) {
    const binding = await host.resolveRunConfiguration!(input);
    const role = input.session.id;
    return { ...binding, model: createFixedModel([
      [{ type: 'tool_call', id: `spawn-${role}`, name: 'spawn_agent', arguments: JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'Finish the original historical task.', ...(role === 'worker' ? {} : { preset: role }) }) }, { ...finish, reason: 'tool_calls' }],
      [finish],
    ]) };
  },
  async resolveChildRunConfiguration(input) {
    return { ...await host.resolveChildRunConfiguration!(input), model: createFixedModel([[{ type: 'text_delta', text: 'Historical child result.' }, finish]]) };
  },
});
host.permissionManagement!(runtime);
try {
  await runtime.createWorkspace({ expectedStoreId, id: 'w', name: 'history', rootUri: pathToFileURL(workspace).href });
  const configurations = [];
  for (const role of defaultTaskRoles) {
    const base = { expectedStoreId, sessionId: role.id, subjectId: 'owner' };
    await runtime.createSession({ ...base, commandId: `create-${role.id}`, workspaceId: 'w', title: role.id });
    await initializeLivePermissionFixture({ ...base, runtime, profile, workspaceId: 'w', mode: 'full', trusted: true });
    await runtime.submitCommand({ ...base, commandId: `work-${role.id}`, request: { kind: 'run.start', content: 'Delegate the historical task.' } });
    await runtime.waitForCommand(`work-${role.id}`, { timeoutMs: 5000 });
    const end = Date.now() + 5000;
    let carrier;
    for (;;) {
      carrier = (await store.listExecutions(role.id)).find(row => row.childSessionId && row.status === 'succeeded');
      if (carrier) break;
      if (Date.now() > end) throw Error(`historical_capture_timeout:${role.id}`);
      await Bun.sleep(5);
    }
    const rootView = await store.getView(role.id);
    const childView = await store.getView(carrier.childSessionId!);
    configurations.push({ role: role.id, root: rootView.runs[0]!.configuration, child: childView.runs[0]!.configuration, carrier: carrier.childConfiguration });
  }
  writeFileSync(new URL('./service-configurations.json', import.meta.url), `${JSON.stringify({ producerRevision: '8e350f99ed6651d2c5db82fca3430d5d0d27b01e', platform: process.platform, runtime: Bun.version, note: 'Captured from the unmodified default Service producer with fixed in-process model adapters. Path-bearing fields are preserved as provenance and are not rewritten or used as portable execution authority.', configurations }, null, 2)}\n`);
} finally {
  await runtime.close();
  removeTemporaryDirectory(directory);
}
